activate.when: The user activates the button (pointer click, Enter or Space) while it is neither disabled nor loading.

rules: Arrange leading, label and trailing in that order inside container; label shows the required non-empty label prop and is the accessible name.

Horizontal spacing: container has edgeInline inline padding and label has labelInline on both inline sides; leading and trailing sit directly against the padding edge and against the label spacing. Without leading or trailing, the label is edgeInline + labelInline from the container edge (edgeInline is twice labelInline).
Size to content up to the available width; keep the label on one line and truncate it with an ellipsis, never truncating the accessible name.
The container height is the greater of minHeight and content height plus paddingBlock; the interaction target meets minTarget in both dimensions without enlarging the visible container.
Leading and trailing content renders at iconSize and inherits the resolved content color.
Resolve the interaction state in this order: disabled, loading, pressed, hover, default. Focus is an independent axis.
Emit activate only when neither disabled nor loading; a disabled or loading button never navigates.
When href is set and the button is not disabled, it navigates to href as a link; otherwise it is a button. Appearance and states are identical in both roles.
Disabled removes the button from sequential focus; loading keeps it focusable, exposes a busy state and keeps the label as the accessible name.
While loading, center loadingIndicator over container and hide leading, label and trailing visually while preserving their layout, so the width does not change.
When loading and disabled are both true, interaction resolves to disabled and loadingIndicator stays visible in the resolved content color.
Draw border only for the outline appearance; it never changes the outer dimensions.
When focus is true and was reached by keyboard, draw a focus indicator of focusWidth in focusColor at focusOffset outside the container.

Color changes between interaction states transition over motionDuration with easingStandard; no transition when reduced motion is requested. The loadingIndicator animation is implementation-defined and slowed or stopped under reduced motion.
In forced-colors mode the container keeps a visible boundary and the focus indicator stays visible.
